fields.cover_sub: For founders: 4 rules to reply safely
fields.step1_body:
Reddit flags accounts that
mostly post their own links.
Buyers want answers, not ads.
The 4 Reply Rules:
fields.step2_body:
Gets you {o:BANNED}:
"Try my app" + a link.
Gets you {b:USERS}:
A full answer. App comes later.
fields.step3_body:
Gets you {o:BANNED}:
Praising it like a fan.
Gets you {b:USERS}:
"I built this, so I'm biased."
fields.step4_body:
Gets you {o:BANNED}:
The same reply in 10 threads.
Gets you {b:USERS}:
One reply for the person asking.
fields.step5_body:
Gets you {o:BANNED}:
Posting, then reading rules.
Gets you {b:USERS}:
Reading the sidebar first.
fields.cta_subtext: Comment REPLY and I'll DM you the Reply Rules: a checklist to run before every Reddit reply.
